title: Gastric / Esophageal Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: DRAFT decision support authored from standard guidelines (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison) - physician decides. ONCOTREE navigator for upper gastrointestinal carcinoma. It captures the physician-entered histology (esophageal squamous vs adenocarcinoma of esophagus/GEJ/stomach), workup, clinical stage/setting, and the biomarkers that steer therapy (HER2, PD-L1 CPS, MMR/MSI, Claudin18.2). Every curative arm routes through a response / restaging or adjuvant step before surveillance, and every advanced arm is refined by line of therapy (first line, progression, second line, later line) before a recommendation. Adenocarcinoma of the distal esophagus, GEJ, and stomach converge on one shared biomarker-directed and line-of-therapy metastatic subtree. The navigator invents no dose, regimen, or eligibility criterion; where no existing StewardMD Standard Protocol fits a leaf, the regimen is described in bullets only. Structural taxonomy consistent with standard guidelines (NCCN Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction / Gastric Cancer); no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides and the existing dose engine computes patient doses.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with standard guidelines (NCCN Gastric / Esophageal), DeVita, and Harrison. Treatment options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

a.text: Perioperative FLOT (4 cycles before and 4 after surgery) is preferred over older platinum-fluoropyrimidine triplets for fit patients with resectable gastric / GEJ adenocarcinoma; benefit is greatest with an R0 D2 resection.

b.text: Neoadjuvant chemoradiation on the CROSS backbone (weekly carboplatin plus paclitaxel with 41.4 Gy) followed by surgery improves R0 rate and survival for locally advanced resectable esophageal / GEJ cancer of either histology.

c.text: Adjuvant nivolumab for up to 1 year is offered when residual pathologic disease (non-pCR) remains after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and R0 resection (CheckMate 577 population).

d.text: First-line metastatic therapy is layered on biomarkers: add anti-PD-1 for PD-L1 CPS-positive tumors, trastuzumab for HER2-positive, zolbetuximab for Claudin18.2-positive, and favor immunotherapy for MMR-deficient / MSI-high disease. Test all four up front on the metastatic sample.

e.text: Second-line ramucirumab plus paclitaxel improves survival over paclitaxel alone in metastatic gastric / GEJ adenocarcinoma progressing after a first-line platinum-fluoropyrimidine; single-agent ramucirumab is an alternative for patients unfit for the combination.

nodes.name: SCC early depth

Then post-treatment surveillance

nodes.name: SCC locally advanced

nodes.name: SCC neoadjuvant chemoRT

bullets: Carboplatin + paclitaxel with concurrent radiotherapy (CROSS backbone)
Esophagectomy 4-8 weeks after chemoradiation in fit patients
Then assess pathologic response to decide adjuvant therapy (next step)

nodes.name: SCC postop response
nodes.title: SCC after chemoRT + surgery: pathologic response

nodes.name: SCC adjuvant nivolumab
nodes.title: SCC, residual disease after R0: adjuvant nivolumab
nodes.description: Adjuvant nivolumab for up to 1 year reduces recurrence when residual pathologic disease remains after neoadjuvant chemoRT and R0 resection (CheckMate 577).
bullets: Nivolumab for up to 1 year, started after recovery from surgery
Monitor for immune-related toxicity; hold / steroid per grade
Then post-treatment surveillance
